verdict.rationale: Windmill ships AI features (AI generation, AI agent steps, MCP), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no policy, setting or contractual statement about whether customer data is used for AI model training. Self-hosting and encrypted variables are adjacent privacy controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
